title: HarfBuzz contextual-class subset traversal can amplify CPU work
ai_system: Anthropic OSS Scanner (model not identified for this discovery)
summary: ContextFormat2/ChainContextFormat2 subset closure and dependency traversal repeatedly walked a large ClassDef for many classes sharing it, causing quadratic work. Maintainer fix computes intersecting classes once and adds a regression font.
ai_role: The primary maintainer commit explicitly says “Discovered by Anthropic's OSS Scanner, as vulnerability ANT-2026-ZCMLEQFJ.” It separately lists Claude Opus 4.8 as a commit co-author; the source does not establish that model as the discovering system or describe its investigative steps.
classification_note: The maintainer source explicitly calls this a vulnerability and describes resource exhaustion from crafted font inputs in the subset path. It does not report exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: The maintainer commit documents a correction that bounds retained glyph/table work and rejects malformed input beyond the source-table budget. The commit does not establish an affected or fixed release boundary.

impacts.conditions: A crafted font processed by the affected OpenType contextual-class subsetting path can cause disproportionate CPU work from repeated ClassDef traversal.
impacts.exploitation: The cited maintainer source reports resource consumption from crafted test inputs; it does not report exploitation in the wild.
